Speciality · Dr. Susheel TyagiType 2 Diabetes

Assessment and ongoing care focused on blood-glucose management and reducing future health risks.

Understanding Type 2 Diabetes

Type 2 diabetes is a long-term metabolic condition in which the body does not use insulin effectively and blood glucose can become elevated. Care is individualised and may include assessment of health risks, monitoring, lifestyle support and clinician-directed treatment.

How the consultation may help

A consultation can provide an opportunity to discuss your health history, symptoms, relevant reports, current medicines and questions. The doctor can explain the assessment and follow-up options that are appropriate to your individual circumstances.

What to bring to your consultation

  • Previous medical reports and relevant test results.
  • A current list of medicines and supplements.
  • Relevant home blood-glucose or blood-pressure readings, where applicable.
  • Questions or concerns you would like to discuss.

This information is general educational content and is not a substitute for an individual medical assessment or emergency care.
